items.raw_excerpt: Political summer meetings, country-wide cultural events and food festivals are just a few of the things happening in Denmark next week. See what else is lined up in next week’s agenda.

items.raw_excerpt: Palakkad Railway Division celebrates Independence Day, highlighting its second national rank and achievements in passenger service and safety.
items.summary_en: Palakkad Railway Division celebrated India's Independence Day. It highlighted its second national rank in performance. The division also shared its achievements in passenger service and safety.

items.raw_excerpt: A burst water main in Porirua was being repaired on Saturday night, with water outages expected to end around 10.30pm.
items.summary_en: A burst water main in Porirua was being repaired on Saturday night. Water outages were expected to end around 10.30pm.

items.raw_excerpt: Iceland is set for generally calm weather this weekend, with light and variable winds or sea breezes across the country. Most areas can expect dry conditions and spells of sunshine, while southern Iceland will be cloudier with occasional light showers, particularly in the afternoon. What’s the Story? Original source: RÚV Light winds and sea breezes…
items.summary_en: Iceland will have calm weather this weekend. Winds will be light and variable, with sea breezes. Most areas will stay dry and sunny, but southern Iceland will be cloudier with light showers in the afternoon.
items.summary_ko: 이번 주말 아이슬란드는 전국적으로 대체로 잔잔한 날씨를 보이겠습니다. 바람은 약하고 방향이 자주 바뀌며 곳곳에 해풍이 불겠습니다. 대부분 지역은 건조하고 맑겠지만, 남부 아이슬란드는 구름이 많고 특히 오후에 가끔 약한 비가 내리겠습니다.
items.title_en: Calm Weather Expected Across Iceland This Weekend

items.title_original: Calm Conditions Expected Across Iceland This Weekend

items.summary_en: A Polish village showed the biggest statue of Virgin Mary in Europe. It is taller than the Christ the Redeemer statue in Rio. People came from nearby towns to see it.
items.summary_ko: 한 폴란드 마을에서 유럽에서 가장 큰 성모 마리아상이 공개됐습니다. 이 동상은 리우의 그리스도상보다 더 높습니다. 주변 마을 주민들이 이를 보러 모였습니다.
items.title_en: Europe's biggest Virgin Mary statue unveiled in a Polish village
items.title_ko: 유럽 최대 성모 마리아상, 폴란드 마을에서 공개
items.title_original: Europe’s biggest Virgin Mary statue – taller than Rio’s Christ the Redeemer – unveiled in Polish village

items.raw_excerpt: Vietnamese men have grown 3.7 cm taller over the past decade, but still stand about 3 cm below the global average, according to the latest national nutrition data.
items.summary_en: Vietnamese men grew 3.7 cm taller over the past ten years. But they are still about 3 cm below the global average height. The numbers come from new national nutrition data.
items.summary_ko: 베트남 남성의 키가 지난 10년 동안 3.7cm 커졌습니다. 그래도 여전히 세계 평균보다 약 3cm 작습니다. 이는 최신 국가 영양 조사 결과에서 나온 내용입니다.
items.title_en: Vietnamese men 3 cm shorter than global average
items.title_ko: 베트남 남성 키, 세계 평균보다 3cm 작아

items.raw_excerpt: Hemorrhoids, leg cramps, sciatica — oh my! Alongside the joy of pregnancy often comes a parade of physical discomfort. Alleviate and prevent common aches with these exercises.
items.summary_en: Pregnancy often brings aches like leg cramps, hemorrhoids, and sciatica. These 5 exercises can help prevent and relieve the pain. They are simple enough to do at home.
items.summary_ko: 임신 중에는 다리 저림, 치질, 좌골 신경통 같은 불편함이 자주 찾아온다. 이 운동 5가지를 하면 흔한 통증을 예방하고 완화하는 데 도움이 된다. 집에서도 쉽게 따라 할 수 있다.
items.title_en: 5 exercises that can prevent (and relieve!) pregnancy pain

items.raw_excerpt: Toronto Zoo has welcomed a female endangered pygmy hippo calf, the third offspring of 20-year-old Kindia.
items.summary_en: Toronto Zoo has a new baby pygmy hippo. The female calf is the third baby of 20-year-old Kindia. Pygmy hippos are endangered animals.
items.summary_ko: 토론토 동물원에 새끼 피그미 하마가 태어났습니다. 암컷 새끼는 20살 어미 킨디아의 세 번째 새끼입니다. 피그미 하마는 멸종 위기 동물입니다.
items.title_en: Toronto Zoo welcomes endangered pygmy hippo calf

items.raw_excerpt: Leiria City Council identified 125 vacant buildings this year within the Urban Rehabilitation Areas (ARU) of the Historic Centre and Nossa Senhora da Encarnação; no properties in a state of ruin were detected, it was announced.
items.summary_en: Leiria City Council found 125 vacant buildings this year. They are in the Urban Rehabilitation Areas of the Historic Centre and Nossa Senhora da Encarnacao. No ruined buildings were found.
items.summary_ko: 레이리아 시청이 올해 역사 지구와 노사 세뇨라 다 엔카르나상 지역의 도시 재생 구역에서 빈 건물 125채를 확인했습니다. 폐허 상태인 건물은 발견되지 않았다고 밝혔습니다.

items.raw_excerpt: A rural pub was closed by authorities after intoxicated punters served booze to themselves, but eight months since it closes the pub is set to reopen.
items.summary_en: A rural pub was closed by authorities after drunk customers served themselves drinks. Eight months later, the pub is set to reopen.
items.summary_ko: 만취한 손님들이 스스로 술을 따라 마셨다가 당국에 의해 폐쇄된 시골 펍이 재개장한다. 폐쇄 8개월 만이다.
items.title_en: Remote NZ pub reopening after months of closure
items.title_original: End of the big dry: Remote pub set to reopen after months of closure - Stuff

items.raw_excerpt: Dal 14 al 16 agosto 2026, l'Acquapark Villaggio della Salute Più apre al pubblico a Monterenzio, sulle colline dell'Appennino bolognese.
items.summary_en: The Acquapark Villaggio della Salute Più water park opens to the public in Monterenzio. It runs from August 14 to 16, 2026. The park sits on the hills of the Bolognese Apennines.
items.summary_ko: 2026년 8월 14일부터 16일까지 몬테렌치오에서 아쿠아파크 빌라지오 델라 살루테 피우가 일반에 공개됩니다. 이 공원은 볼로냐 아펜니노 언덕에 자리 잡고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Water park opens in Monterenzio, Italy
items.title_original: Acquapark Villaggio della Salute Più, Monterenzio - Mentelocale

items.raw_excerpt: Das veraltete Pongauer Heimatmuseum bekommt ein modernes Konzept mit Schwerpunkten auf die Protestantenvertreibung und die Geschichte rund um die Goldegger Deserteure. Bund, Land und Gemeinde stemmen die Investition gemeinsam. Ende 2027 soll das Museum neu eröffnet werden.
items.summary_en: The old local museum in Goldegg Castle is getting a modern new concept. It will focus on the history of expelled Protestants and the Goldegg deserters. The federal government, state, and town share the costs, and the museum should reopen by the end of 2027.
items.summary_ko: 골데그 성에 있는 낡은 향토 박물관이 현대적인 새 콘셉트로 다시 태어난다. 개신교도 추방과 골데그 탈영병의 역사가 전시의 중심이 된다. 연방 정부와 주, 지자체가 비용을 함께 부담하며, 박물관은 2027년 말에 다시 문을 열 예정이다.
items.title_en: Historic Goldegg Castle museum gets a new concept
items.title_ko: 골데그 성 향토 박물관, 새 콘셉트로 재개관 준비
items.title_original: Heimatmuseum im Schloss Goldegg wird für mehr als eine Million Euro auf neue Beine gestellt - Salzburger Nachrichten
